epsom.reason: Returning ACT incumbent with an established personal-vote pattern; preserve the ACT electorate lead despite National party-vote strength.
National party vote is not treated as National candidate support in Epsom.

tamaki.reason: The 2023 ACT winner is not standing; remove much of the inherited personal-vote advantage.
National has a competitive replacement candidate and is treated as the principal beneficiary of the ACT incumbent retirement.

auckland-central.reason: Returning Green incumbent and demonstrated candidate vote.

christchurch-central.reason: The 2023 Labour incumbent is not standing.

maungakiekie.reason: Current Labour candidate strength in a competitive seat.

mt-roskill.reason: Returning former Labour electorate MP challenging a narrow National baseline.

northcote.reason: Returning former Labour electorate MP challenging the National baseline.

wairarapa.reason: High-profile Labour candidate challenging the National baseline.

te-tai-tokerau.reason: Current Green candidate is treated as a major contender in a volatile Māori electorate.
Candidate turnover penalty relative to the 2023 Te Pāti Māori winner.

te-tai-tonga.reason: Current Labour candidate adjustment in a volatile Māori electorate.
Candidate turnover penalty relative to the 2023 Te Pāti Māori winner.
